page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Notes stand in the right margin, partly cut off and not legible. Faint bleed-through from the reverse side and the neighbouring page edge at the left and right edges is not transcribed. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, gathering signature at bottom left.

main_text.p: letus ab hofte Persa capta, ac pessimè mulctata: cives,qui cædi supersuere, in Persiam abducti, conjuges & liberi in prædam versi, urbs vastata, ager inter hos divisus. Samii, quibus ducum suorum perfidia vehementer displicebat, aut similia metuentes, aut Æacis imperium, quem sine dubio reducturi victores erant, subire nolentes, conscensis celeriter navibus, antequam ille adveniret, relictà patriâ cum paucis Milesiis fugâ elapsis in Siciliam delati, Zanclam tum forte ab habitatoribus desertam occuparunt, ibique sedes posuerunt. Reliqui domi manentes Æacem dominum receperunt. Urbi à Persis parsum[illegible, ~8 letters] ob proditionem: Chius, Lesbus, Tene-dus anno sequente à Persis & Phoenicibus in potestatem redactæ, & afflictæ vehementer: Cæteræ civitates Ionicæ in continente etiam subjugatæ. Ab hinc[illegible, ~6 letters] tota Ionia jugum Persicum pertulit ad id tempus, quo post Xerxem & Mardonium devictos Persæ totâ Græciâ ejecti, etiam imperium in Ionas dimittere sunt coacti. Ita Samus quoq; libertati reddita, & cum Chiis & Lesbiis fœdere cum Græcis victoribus conjuncta. Classis Ionum debellata ac dissipata à Phoenicibus & Persis[illegible, ~10 letters] Olympiadis LXXI anno primo. Ionia jugo Persico liberata Olympiadis LXXI[?][illegible, ~6 letters]

page.notes:
The right margin notes are cut off and shadowed, so they are marked as illegible and not read. The numeral at the end of the last line (LXXI) runs into the margin marking and is doubtful. The "1 2" at the foot is taken as the gathering signature. The text is set as one continuous paragraph with no indent, so it is one

. The left-edge and bottom-right fragments are show-through or the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
